info.title: Softbot Token Check
info.description: Solana token safety check: verdict (safe/caution/avoid), 0-100 risk score and reasons from mint/freeze authority, Token-2022 extensions, holder concentration, age and DEX liquidity. Use when an agent is about to buy, swap, accept or recommend an unfamiliar Solana token. Not financial advice. Paid per call via x402 (USDC on Solana). Invalid mints and upstream failures are not charged.
